Sources said the auto sector is grappling with the problem of adjusting the cess charged on vehicleswhich have moved out ofthe factory gates and have reached the dealerships, but will likely be sold only after September 22 when the cess is technically done away with. The mechanism to adjustthecess already paidisnowa festering issue.
